# Business AI

Business AI is a UK-focused small-business software platform for website enquiries, lead capture, bookings, business knowledge and optional AI-assisted marketing.

Canonical website: https://getbusiness-ai.com/
App: https://app.getbusiness-ai.com/

## Main product pages
- AI Receptionist: https://getbusiness-ai.com/ai-receptionist/
- Small Business AI: https://getbusiness-ai.com/small-business-ai/
- AI Marketing: https://getbusiness-ai.com/ai-marketing/

## Product scope
- AI Receptionist currently focuses on web enquiries.
- Business owners can choose human-first, balanced or AI-first handling.
- Business Knowledge can provide context such as services, FAQs and pricing.
- AI Marketing is an optional add-on for content drafts and planning.
- Human review and handover remain part of the product design.

Support: support@getbusiness-ai.com
